note: Ground-truth LAYOUT GEOMETRY measured off the iOS 27 reference frames (iPhone 11, 828x1792 px @ 2x = 414x896 pt). A photo is a competent authority for a shipped geometry: the pixels are what Apple shipped. Each measurement may carry the GT reading (authority), the ROM's own layout derivation, and a live device read of the ROM. Units are iOS-pt on the 414 pt GT panel unless stated otherwise, so the ROM's dp values are converted with x 414/392.7.

evidence.device-read: B, 2026-10-21 (device pass, and a correction of B's own earlier claim): the RAW trailing space on the device is 109.8 dp = 115.8 iOS-pt, because the fourth cell is EMPTY and the icons do not spread - 20 dp of bar padding + one empty cell (60 dp icon + 29.45 dp gap = 89.45 dp) = 109.45 dp, and the device reads 109.8. The value recorded here is the COMPARABLE part (the padding, 20 dp = 21.08 iOS-pt); the empty-cell space is its own fact below. This is the slot rule made visible: the trailing space is a function of the EMPTY CELLS, not a fixed 20 dp.

B, 2026-10-21: one EMPTY dock cell occupies 89.45 dp (a 60 dp icon + the 29.45 dp derived gap) - the space a fourth app would take. The GT has no empty cell (four apps, four cells), so there is nothing to compare it with; the number matters because it is what the dock's trailing space grows by when a slot is empty, and it is identical to the icon pitch.
